title: From Document Layout to Causal Topology: An End-to-End Architecture for Temporal Causal Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.34094v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) generally lack deep causal reasoning capabilities in temporal reasoning. Inspired by document layout reordering, this paper proposes a paradigm shift from discrete narratives to causal topologies. It constructs two architectures: a training-free neuro-symbolic framework, temporal causal reasoning agent (TCR-Agent), which achieves interpretable causal deduction and counterfactual truncation through external causal graph instantiation and a symbolic intervention engine; and an end-to-end model, temporal causal reasoning former (TCR-Former), which internalizes these mechanisms into the Transformer attention space via a Causal-Topological Attention Mask and temporal span biases. Experiments on the TempoCausal benchmark demonstrate that TCR-Agent comprehensively surpasses existing training-free baselines. translated_title: 从文档布局到因果拓扑：一种面向时序因果推理的端到端架构
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通常缺乏在时序推理中进行深度因果推理的能力。受文档布局重排序的启发，本文提出了一种从离散叙事到因果拓扑的范式转变。该研究构建了两种架构：一是免训练的神经符号框架——时序因果推理智能体（TCR-Agent），它通过外部因果图实例化和符号干预引擎实现可解释的因果演绎与反事实截断；二是端到端模型——时序因果推理模型（TCR-Former），它通过因果拓扑注意力掩码和时序跨度偏置将这些机制内化到Transformer的注意力空间中。在TempoCausal基准上的实验表明，TCR-Agent全面超越了现有的免训练基线方法，同时TCR-Former比最先进（SOTA）方法的准确率高出16.5%。
tldr: 本文提出从离散叙事到因果拓扑的范式转变，构建了免训练神经符号智能体TCR-Agent和端到端模型TCR-Former两种时序因果推理架构，后者在TempoCausal基准上的准确率比SOTA方法高出16.5%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a paradigm shift from discrete narratives to causal topologies, introducing both a training-free neuro-symbolic agent (TCR-Agent) and an end-to-end model (TCR-Former), with the latter achieving 16.5% higher accuracy than SOTA methods on the TempoCausal benchmark.
